add_rc_deps(mmc.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/mmc.ico)

# mmc.exe is all Rust (mmc-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mmc-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# console.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mmc-rust/src/mmc/console.rs)
# misc.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mmc-rust/src/mmc/misc.rs)
# mmc.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mmc-rust/src/mmc/mmc.rs)
# mscfile.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mmc-rust/src/mmc/mscfile.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(mmc_shims OBJECT rust_varargs_shim.c)
target_compile_definitions(mmc_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(mmc_res OBJECT mmc.rc)
target_compile_definitions(mmc_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(mmc_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(MMC_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/uuid/libuuid.a)
add_cargo_module(mmc mmc-cargo mmc.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE mmc-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mmc_shims mmc_res ${MMC_REUSED})
